User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system with role-based access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, matching Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: User's email, used for Firebase Authentication.

role.description: Role of the user (admin, parkshopping, madureirashopping).

unitId.description: Reference to the Unit the user is associated with. (e.g. 'Park Shopping')

Unit.title: Unit
Unit.description: Represents a store unit (e.g., Park Shopping, Madureira Shopping).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Unit entity.

name.description: Name of the unit (e.g., Park Shopping).

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a catalog product that can be stocked.

type.description: The type of the product (Nacional or Importado).

StockItem.title: StockItem
StockItem.description: Represents an item in stock at a specific unit.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StockItem entity.

name.description: Denormalized name of the stock item (e.g., 'Chocolate').

quantity.description: Quantity of the item in stock.

type.description: Denormalized type of the stock item (e.g., 'Nacional', 'Importado').

unitId.description: Reference to the Unit where the item is stocked. (e.g. 'Park Shopping')

StockTransaction.title: StockTransaction
StockTransaction.description: Represents a transaction that modifies the stock level of an item.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StockTransaction entity.

stockItemId.description: Reference to the StockItem involved in the transaction.

quantityChange.description: The amount the stock level changed (positive for addition, negative for removal).

operatorName.description: Name of the user who performed the transaction.

unitId.description: Denormalized Unit ID for security rules.

CashFlowRecord.title: CashFlowRecord
CashFlowRecord.description: Represents a record of cash flow, including sales and expenses.

paymentMethod.description: The name of the payment method, e.g., 'Pix'

unitId.description: Denormalized Unit ID for security rules.

ProductSaleRecord.title: ProductSaleRecord
ProductSaleRecord.description: Represents a record of sales by product category.

productCategory.description: Name of the product category sold.

unitId.description: Denormalized Unit ID for security rules.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: Represents a payment method (e.g., Dinheiro, Pix, Credito, Debito).

PaymentFee.title: PaymentFee
PaymentFee.description: Stores the percentage fee for a payment method at a specific unit.

unitId.description: The ID of the store unit.

feePercentage.description: The fee as a percentage, e.g., 1.99 for 1.99%.

FixedCost.title: FixedCost
FixedCost.description: Stores the monthly fixed costs for a specific unit.

unitId.description: The ID of the store unit.

ProductCategory.title: ProductCategory
ProductCategory.description: Represents a user-defined category of product sold (e.g. candy, chocolate).

DailyMetric.title: DailyMetric
DailyMetric.description: Stores daily performance metrics for a specific unit.

unitId.description: The ID of the store unit.

averageTicket.description: The average ticket value for the day.

numberOfSales.description: The total number of sales transactions for the day.

definition.description: Stores fee percentages for payment methods.
Stores monthly fixed costs for each unit.
